profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack Development (React, Python, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, AWS)
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with over 4 years experience in full stack development using React, Python, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, and AWS. Before that, I spent over 8 years in mechanical and aerospace engineering where I learned to think in systems and optimize for efficiency and reliability. I used those skills to lead reliability initiatives at Beckman Coulter that saved $10M annually and cut failures by 75%. I've since applied that same rigor in software at Valor Performance, where I built a HubSpot sync service processing 85k+ PostgreSQL fields across 5,000+ clients, then optimized its runtime from over an hour to under a minute.

That pattern of finding root cause, understanding the system end-to-end, and re-architecting for scale shows up throughout my work. I automated 60+ client reports with Python, pandas, and AWS Lambda, modernized a five-year-old JavaScript stack for speed and security, and built GraphQL and REST APIs. I used Redis for caching and Sidekiq for async jobs to keep the app responsive under load, and built front ends using React, Redux, and Jest that helped coaches visualize schedules and payments while giving admins a clean way to audit client data.

I’m a contributor to open source through astroSpeed, where I built Node.js + Puppeteer performance auditing tools that graphed Lighthouse results over time using Apex Charts.

I'm currently exploring new opportunities where I can bring my blend of systems thinking and full-stack engineering to a team solving hard problems. Always happy to connect. Feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Evaluated and improved AI-generated code, algorithms, workflows, and system designs across Python, TypeScript, and React through leading AI training platforms (DataAnnotation, Outlier AI, Snorkel AI), contributing to training data quality for large language models.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved marketing data accuracy by creating a Ruby on Rails sync service for 5,000+ clients (~85k PostgreSQL fields), cutting runtime from 1 hr to <1 min through HubSpot’s batch API and optimized database queries.
• Prevented dozens of Helpdesk requests each month and increased admin efficiency by developing a React + GraphQL page to precisely query multi-table data, enabling auditing and filtering of client changes.
• Eliminated 95% of deployment failures caused by dependency mismatches by implementing Python Poetry and standardizing Docker/server environments.
• Empowered Customer Success and Sales teams by automating 60+ client usage reports using Python, Pandas, PostgreSQL, and AWS Lambda.
• Enhanced team productivity by mentoring junior engineers, establishing code standards, reviewing 150+ pull requests, and pairing on 100+ sessions — raising code quality and accelerating feature delivery.
• Ensured platform uptime as rotating Helpdesk lead, resolving urgent production issues such as site outages, data corruption, and deployment errors to minimize downtime.
• Modernized JavaScript stack by upgrading React, Webpack, Babel, Node.js, and related packages (5+ years outdated), enhancing security, reducing load times, and enabling modern development features.
• Reduced unlogged sessions by 90% by creating Sidekiq email workers and a React Router page with session tracking and pagination, ensuring accurate reporting and timely coach payouts.
• Delivered dynamic Material UI components for 50+ coach bios, adapting to variable content while maintaining a responsive, consistent user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Ruby on Rails · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · PostgreSQL · Node.js · Redux.js

projects.title: PT-Conf | Open Source Parent-Teacher Conference Scheduler
projects.description:
• Incorporated Redux Toolkit to create reducers that modify schedule availability and conference information in app state while simplifying and standardizing the Redux store setup.
• Implemented Node.js/Express server to make and delete appointments and update teacher, student, and parent information via modularized routers and controllers.
• Created NoSQL Database to best store and retrieve variably nested documents containing teacher, parent, student, and appointment information efficiently.
• Leveraged Material UI’s wide range of options and predefined configurations to quickly create UI components that made every app function easy to recognize and use.
• Configured webpack to enable hot module replacement, which improved development speed by reducing the time needed to see code changes’ effects.

projects.title: Expired | Open Source Food Expiration Reminder
projects.description:
• Integrated PostgreSQL in order to store relational data (users, their fridges, and their food expiration dates) in a reliable ACID compliant database.
• Utilized Passport to quickly and unobtrusively integrate Google’s Oauth 2.0 implementation into Node.js server.
